message: Please quote a T75 Row-Crop with Delivery and setup.

Happy to quote that. The T75 Row-Crop (75 hp, enclosed cab with A/C, 4WD) with Delivery and setup (delivered within 150 miles, set up, and walked through on site) comes to $68,900 at list: $68,000 for the tractor plus $900 for delivery. Payment is due at checkout. If you'd like, I can also quote the front loader or the 3-year extended warranty.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the same T75 at $65,950 and delivery at $875 ($66,825 total). I'm ready to pay today if you can match or come closer to that.

Thanks for the quick reply and for being ready to buy today. Our pricing is fixed at list, so I can't match or discount. The T75 Row-Crop with Delivery and setup stays at $68,900 ($68,000 tractor + $900 delivery). That includes delivery within 150 miles, full setup, and an on-site walkthrough.
